result.topic_en: General solution of infinitely small oscillatory motions: kinetic energy as a quadratic form in the velocities of the variables p, q, r, a quadratic potential to be minimized, and the resulting linear second-order differential equations.
result.transcription:
Allgemeine Auflösung der unendl. kl. Bewegg
Es sein $p, q, r$ etc. die erforderlichen Variabeln;
in ihnen ausgedrückt
Lebendige Kraft $(1)\left(\frac{\partial p}{\partial t}\right)^2 + (2.2)\left(\frac{dq}{dt}\right)^2 + (3.3)\left(\frac{dr}{\partial t}\right)^2 +$
$+ 2(1,2)\left(\frac{\partial p}{\partial t}\right)\left(\frac{dq}{dt}\right) +$ etc.
Allgemeiner Ausdruck der Grösse die ein Minimum
werden $\Sigma.\int$ Kraft. virt. Mom.
$= [1,1].\, pp + [2,2]\, qq + [-[3,3] r r-] +$ etc
$+ 2[1,2]\, pq +$ etc.
Dann hat man die Gleichungen
$0 = (1,1)\frac{d^2 p}{dt^2} + (1,2)\frac{d^2 q}{dt^2} + (1,3)\frac{d^2 r}{dt^2} +$
$+[1,1]\, p + [1,2]\, q + [1,3]\, r +$ etc
$0 = (1,2)\frac{d^2 p}{dt^2} + (2,2)\frac{d^2 q}{dt^2} + (2,3)\frac{d^2 r}{dt^2} +$
$+[1,2]\, p + [2,2]\, q + [2,3]\, r +$ etc.

methods.what: Potential (sum of integrals of virtual moments of forces) as a quadratic form in the coordinates, to be a minimum
Linear second-order equations of motion for small oscillations (mass matrix times accelerations plus stiffness matrix times coordinates equals zero)
